page.layout: One title page in a decorative border; the title is centred in several lines of large and small type. Handwritten shelfmarks in the top left corner are not transcribed. A faint show-through of text from the reverse is visible and not transcribed.; One page of title text, centred, with a woodcut device between the lines and the printer's imprint below; the device is flanked by the date on left and right; a decorative border frames the text on the left, right and bottom, carrying no printed text.

main_text.l: menti libri orum Targumim seu Paraphrasibus Chal-

page.notes: The word "libri orum" in the fourth title line is printed with a space and may be "librorum"; the printed form is given as seen. The line "Item" and the line "IN TARGUM HIEROSOLYMITANO" are partly overlaid by a dark ink stamp at the right; the final letters of "HIEROSOLYMITANO" and the stamp itself are uncertain. The last line is cut off at the foot of this part of the page. The woodcut device shows an oval with the legend "COLLOQ" and "SAL" around a landscape; the date MDC and XXII flank it on the left and right. Printer's device has no printed text other than the legend.
